name: [Infiltrate Black Onyx Tower]
Get past the guards in the lobby and reach the door.
Break down the door and head inside.
Wh-who's there?!
Intruders! Sound the alarm!
How did they get in here?!
Don't let them through!
Stay alert!
Watch the entrance!
Nobody gets past the lobby!
Word from $npcName:11004639$. We're to keep moving.
Got it. Clear the way up!
Something's not right. This is going too smoothly...
You don't think it's a trap, do you?
The Black Onyx is striking back. Defeat them all.
You picked the wrong tower to walk into!
Watch the side passages. More of them are coming!
There they are!
Get them!
You won't leave this tower alive!
One more push. Hold them off and we'll reach the elevator!
The elevator is open. Take it to the next floor.
Stay sharp. I heard something outside.
Preparing security release code.
Enter the security release code.
Security release successful
Security release failed
Security release code preparation (2/3)
Enter the security release code. (2/3)
Security release successful
Security release failed
Security release code preparation (3/3)
Enter the security release code. (3/3)
Security release successful
Security release failed
This door's reinforced. We'll have to break it down!
Destroy the door to enter the office.
They made it past the lobby?!
Stop them before they reach the third floor!
The way to the third floor runs through this office. Keep going!
Protect the documents!
Nobody touches the boss's files!
That door has a security lock. See if you can crack the code.
[Security System Challenge]\nQuickly enter the numbers as they appear.\nIf you fail 3 times, the security system will punish you.
[Success]\nYou entered it correctly.\nThe way to $map:02000534$ is opening.
[Failure]\nThe security system doesn't like you.\nThe lock device is activating.
Fine. If the lock won't open, I'll break it by hand!
[Battle of Patience]\nCan't be helped. Just force it open.
Nice work! The door's down. Let's move.
The stairs are clear. On to the third floor!
Intruders on this floor!
Call for backup!
Don't let them near the office!
Get them!
Search the labs and find out what the Black Onyx is planning.
How did you get up here?!
Protect the research data!
Stop right there!
Good. The first lab should be just ahead.
Oh my, visitors~ Let's see how far you get.
Lady Haren is watching! Don't let her down!
For the Black Onyx!
So this is where it gets interesting.
Go on, then. Entertain me~
Get out of my lab!
Don't touch that device!
This machine must be what they're guarding.
You'll go no further!
The second lab is off limits!
Another one of these machines. I should shut it down.
That's two. On to the next room.
Time to end this!
They're at the third lab!
Hide the data, quickly!
We can't hold them for long!
Stop, or I'll destroy it all!
Too late. I've already seen enough.
Stop them before they reach the last lab!
You can't be in here!
Those files are classified!
Check that computer. The plans must be on it.
Oh, reading other people's files? How rude~
Lady Haren, they've reached the computer!
This is it. Their whole plan is on this screen.
I'll copy what I can.
Got it? Then get out of there. Something's coming!
What's that noise?
Here it comes! Take it down!
Intruders! You'll be my first test!
Upgrade, start!
Stop the upgrade before it finishes!
Upgrade complete! Now you all go down with me!
No! The upgrade failed!
Well done! I've opened a way upstairs.
The portal to $map:02000535$ has opened.
An intruder in the executive wing?!
Seize them!
Protect the meeting room!
They're not getting past me!
That's the first group. Let's keep moving.
There are too many of them. I need to be smarter about this.
Watch the floor and time your steps to slip past the guards.
Did you hear something?
Just the wind.
It's been quiet tonight.
Too quiet.
The executives are meeting again?
I could use a break.
Keep your eyes open.
Shift change is soon.
Stop talking and stay at your post.
The meeting is running long today.
The boss must be in a foul mood.
Better not get in the executives' way.
You said it. Back to your post.
The tea for the meeting room is ready.
Hurry, or Lady Haren will be cross.
There! An intruder!
Surround them!
Those must be the executives. Let me listen in.
The operation is on schedule.
Then nothing can stop us now.
You've heard enough. Find the way forward before you're spotted.
I need to get out of here before they notice me.
Can you hear me? I've opened the passage to the terrace.
Go now. I can't keep it open for long.
They're on the terrace!
Cut them off!
We've got your back. Keep going!
Leave these guys to us. Find the way in!
Don't let them reach the safe!
Hi! I'm the free-spirited Black Bean! Playing is the best!\nPlay with me from now on!
If you choose a different direction than me, you win;\nif you choose the same direction, you lose!
If you lose five times, it's game over!\nThe longer you go, the higher you score!
If you rank high enough, you'll get a gift! Pretty good deal, huh?\nThen let's begin~ Boing-boing!
I won't lose to you!
Round and round~!
Did I just lose?!
I won!
Ne-ne ne-ne ne~ You lost~ Pbbblt!
Ugh! Damn it!
You won't catch me that easily!
Thank you. With this, I can begin the treatment.
Please stand back while I tend to the war chief.
War chief, please... come back to us.
Ugh...
